# UpWon

> UpWon is India's enterprise software suite for food manufacturers, FMCG companies and franchise networks. One integrated platform runs production, distribution, retail, HR and finance on the same data — built for food, not retrofitted. Live in 30–45 days.

UpWon is built by Byte Elephants Technologies (Nashik, Maharashtra, India). It serves businesses doing roughly ₹2 Cr to ₹500 Cr in revenue across bakery, dairy, sweets & namkeen, spices & agro, beverages, food processing, FMCG distribution and QSR/franchise.

## Products (the 7-platform suite)

- [UpWon ERP](https://upwon.in/products/erp): Batch-driven production, recipe BOM, multi-plant control, finance, FSSAI & GST compliance.
- [UpWon SFA-DMS](https://upwon.in/products/sfa-dms): Beat planning, secondary-sales capture, distributor stock visibility, scheme control.
- [UpWon FMS](https://upwon.in/products/fms): Franchise onboarding, royalty, outlet POS, central kitchen and aggregator orders.
- [UpWon POS](https://upwon.in/products/pos): Offline-first counter billing with Swiggy/Zomato/ONDC, loyalty and settlement.
- [UpWon HREasy](https://upwon.in/products/hrms): Multi-state payroll, biometric attendance, PF/ESIC/TDS, statutory compliance.
- [UpWon WMS](https://upwon.in/products/wms): FEFO putaway, expiry alerts and temperature zones for perishable warehouses.
- [UpWon Vendor Portal](https://upwon.in/products/vendor-portal): Supplier onboarding, RFQs, PO confirmation, quality self-certification.
